verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own docs describe it as "an open source platform," and its source is hosted on a public GitHub repo, so the open-license half of the story has thin first-party support. Nothing in the pack covers governance or protection against relicensing. A community remark about the license is too vague to count as a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: the specific license named (e.g. Apache 2.0), any open-governance or foundation model, evidence of CLA or relicensing protections, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on an open license and open governance so the tool cannot be relicensed out from under my company

citations.quote: Pulumi is an open source platform for building, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure using your favorite programming languages.
